Adding some practical pairing notes from infra/serving perspective:

- Candidate families to evaluate: MBase-7B-quant (fast, single-GPU friendly) and MBase-13B-ptq (higher quality; can be sharded for throughput).
- Suggested routing policy: prefix-classify -> small LLM for intent + metadata -> high-quality fallback for summarization tasks.

Throughput sketch (very rough):
- Baseline single instance (MBase-7B-quant): ~18 tok/s per GPU at 512-context; ~40 tok/s with aggressive quantization and perf kernels.
- MBase-13B-ptq: ~10-14 tok/s per GPU at 1024-context depending on kernel selection.

If Samantha can share the expected request size (prompt + expected response tokens), we can produce hourly token bands. For quick visibility, if median prompt is ~120 tokens and median response ~300 tokens, then per-request tokens ~420. At 200 RPS peak that maps to ~30M tokens/hour (200 * 420 * 60 * 60).

Attachment: quick-throughput-estimate.xlsx

- Ben
